player_prompt.intro:
Udlala umdlalo weMinesweeper.
Injongo yoludlalo kukhulula zonke i-seli ezingena miminiki.
Ukwenza isithuko, nciphisa kuphela irowe nekolomu ucezu ufuna ukukhulula usebenzisa ifomathi:
- `[row col]`: Khulula i-seli kwirowe nekolomu ezichaziwe.
Ngokwesibonelo:
- `[3 2]` ukukhulula i-seli kwiRowe 3, iKolomu 2.
- `[5 6]` ukukhulula i-seli kwiRowe 5, iKolomu 6.
Kwisithuko sakho sokuqala, uya kukhulula indawo malunga ne-seli uyikhethayo ukuqinisekisa kuqala kwakhuselekile.
Ilayouthi yebhodi yamanje iyonjulwa ngezantsi. I-seli ezingeziwa ziboniswa ngembotyi ('.'), namagugu akhululwa abonisa inani la miminiki ejikeleziwe.
Qaphela ukhetha i-seli ezikhululwe.
Nanku ilayouthi yebhodi yamanje:

invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Iinkcukacha zomqolo kunye neekholamu ezichaziweyo ziphume ngaphandle kwemida.

outcome.turn_limit: Umda wenguqu ufikelelwe. Uphumelele ekufumaneni {percent}% yeeseli ezikhuselekileyo.
